Package neqsim.process.diagnostics

Class CausalTopologyModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.diagnostics.CausalTopologyModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CausalTopologyModel extends Object implements Serializable
Promotes statistical lead-lag relationships to causal candidates using flowsheet topology.

RelationshipGraph finds which tags move together and which moves first, but statistical correlation is not causation. This class overlays the physical process connectivity (which equipment feeds which) on the statistical edges: a lead-lag edge whose leading tag sits on equipment that is upstream of the following tag's equipment is promoted to a CausalTopologyModel.Verdict.CAUSAL_CANDIDATE; a strong edge that does not follow any process path is flagged as CausalTopologyModel.Verdict.COMMON_CAUSE_OR_ARTIFACT (a shared hidden driver or an instrument artifact rather than a direct cause).

Usage example: 

 Map<String, Set<String>> downstream = CausalTopologyModel.buildDownstreamAdjacency(processSystem);
 CausalTopologyModel model = new CausalTopologyModel(downstream, tagToEquipment);
 List<CausalTopologyModel.CausalEdge> edges = model.classify(relationships);

1.0

    • buildDownstreamAdjacency

      public static Map<String,Set<String>> buildDownstreamAdjacency(ProcessSystem processSystem)
      Builds a directed downstream-adjacency map from a process system by matching shared stream objects.

      Equipment B is downstream of A when an outlet stream of A is the same object as an inlet stream of B (process systems share stream objects by reference).

      Parameters:
      processSystem - the process system to analyze
      Returns:
      map of equipment name to the set of directly downstream equipment names

    • safeStreams
